styleLock.backgroundSystem: alternate clean studio white, leopard-texture strip, and real street or indoor scenes
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright natural daylight for lifestyle shots, soft even studio light with soft contact shadow for packshots
styleLock.surfaceSystem: painted concrete street ground, light wood home floor, seamless white studio surface
styleLock.typography: bold modern geometric sans-serif headlines in #1A1A1A with a light English caption line beneath, short and readable
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons with red numbered circles
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle for packshots, consistent product scale, centered placement, clean margins around the product
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: youthful street-fashion footwear ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of warm white background #F7F5F2, deep charcoal #1A1A1A, leopard-tan accent #C08349, and feature red #E0392B reserved for numbered labels; warm tone; bold modern geometric sans-serif headlines in #1A1A1A with a light English caption line beneath, short and readable; backgrounds alternate between clean studio white, leopard-texture strip, and real street or indoor scenes; bright natural daylight for lifestyle shots, soft even studio light with soft contact shadow for packshots; consistent thin-line icons with numbered red circles; stable product scale, centered placement, clean margins around the product; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 用街拍拼贴与豹纹氛围承接点击，一秒建立潮流外穿的定位
shots.camera: collage top half with tilted vertical photo cards; product floating below at a slight 3/4 angle
shots.lighting: bright even editorial lighting with soft shadows
shots.background: warm white #F7F5F2 with a leopard-texture strip in #C08349
shots.props: three vertical street-style photo cards with generic cropped fashion figures
shots.whitespace: editorial collage composition with breathing margins around the photo cards and the floating product
shots.textZone: top center headline zone plus one line English caption beneath
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic trend-opening hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Upper half: three tilted vertical street-style photo cards with generic cropped fashion figures form a collage; lower half: {product} floats at a slight 3/4 angle above a leopard-texture strip in #C08349. Bright even editorial lighting with soft shadows. Background warm white #F7F5F2. Product occupies 50-60% of frame in an editorial collage composition with breathing margins around the cards and the product. Top center headline in #1A1A1A reading 「{callout_1}」 with a small light English caption line beneath. Clean layout with a short readable headline, no dense body text. Negative: no brand logos, no recognizable faces, no watermark, no garbled text, no dense paragraphs, no extra props, no cut-off product edges.

shots.intent: 以真实上脚比例与格调文案强化百搭印象，推动代入感

shots.background: warm white #F7F5F2 with a small leopard-texture corner block #C08349, terracotta tile floor under on-foot shots

shots.textZone: lower-left headline band plus one caption line

shots.intent: 同机位并排呈现跟型与配色选项，消除选择疑虑

shots.lighting: soft even studio light, soft contact shadows, no lighting drift between variants
shots.whitespace: even white gutters between the four grid cells
shots.textZone: two frame-bracket labels above each grid column
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce variant grid of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Four pairs arranged in a 2x2 grid, all photographed at the same slight 3/4 hero angle with identical lighting: two flat-sole pairs and two wedge-sole pairs, each combining a black sole #1A1A1A with either a grey-toned printed strap #D9D9D6 or a tan-toned printed strap #C08349. Soft even studio light, soft contact shadows. Background clean white #FFFFFF. Products overall occupy 60-70% with even white gutters between the four cells. Two frame-bracket labels 「{callout_3}」 and 「{callout_4}」 in #1A1A1A above each column. Negative: no mixed lighting between variants, no texture loss on dark soles, no brand logos, no watermark, no extra text, no cut-off edges.

provenance.notes: 12 片详情页长图切片（790x1200，重叠 60px）提炼。已剥离：鞋底品牌印字、模特面部身份、原图全部文案（原句改为 {callout}/{selling_point} 文案槽位）。纠正记录：源文件夹名为「鞋」，实际内容为女式豹纹宽带厚底一字拖，L1 仍归「鞋靴」，L2 按图片实际内容定为「凉拖鞋」；原文中防臭吸汗、防滑耐磨等功效词均未保留，未写入任何未经证实的承诺；原图分平跟/高跟两版与灰/黄两色，模版以平跟厚底版为主线、VARIANT 镜覆盖两版两色。
